report.direction_method: Increase is positive; actual unchanged targets are excluded. Predicted change > 0 is increase, otherwise decrease/non-increase. ROC-AUC uses continuous predicted price minus observed origin price. Undefined metrics are null. Identical origins per model; validation selection never uses test.
report.methodology: Same original chronological boundaries and genuine weekly observations. Each tree refits at every origin on targets strictly before it. Hyperparameters and expanding/156-week windows chosen by purged walk-forward validation MAE only. ARIMA/SARIMA orders chosen on validation, parameters refit before test and past-filtered. Actual ties excluded only for binary metrics; continuous price-change scores for AUC. No class resampling: regression forecasts preserve the observed balanced test distribution. Weekly 7/14/28 are historical, never 30-day or current inference.
